lang.name: English
login.title: Sign in with your phone number
login.demoHint: Tap a worker to fill in their number. In demo mode the code appears on screen.
login.wrongCode: That code is wrong. Check it and try again.
login.expired: The code has expired. Send a new one.
login.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
common.offline: No internet. Check-ins are saved on this phone and sent later.
fatigue.title: You are working too much
fatigue.LONG_SHIFT: One shift was {value} hours. The limit is {limit}.
fatigue.WEEKLY_HOURS: {value} hours in 7 days. The limit is {limit}.
fatigue.SHORT_REST: Only {value} hours of rest between shifts. You need {limit}.
fatigue.NO_WEEKLY_OFF: {value} days in a row without a day off.
fatigue.advice: Rest is your right. Your manager sees this alert too.
checkin.title: Check in
checkin.doneOut: Checked out. Today: {hours} hours, {ot} hours overtime.
checkin.queued: Saved on this phone. It will be sent when the internet is back.
checkin.outside: You are {distance} m from the site. Move closer or scan the QR.
checkin.wrongCode: That is not today's site code.
checkin.noLocation: Location is off. Scan the QR or type the code.
checkin.noCamera: This phone cannot scan here. Type the code instead.
checkin.pointCamera: Point the camera at the QR poster
pay.title: My pay
pay.minWageOk: Your daily rate ₹{rate} meets the minimum wage of ₹{min}.
pay.minWageLow: Your daily rate ₹{rate} is below the minimum wage of ₹{min}. Ask about this.
pay.askPlaceholder: Say or type what is wrong (optional)
pay.speech: {month}. You receive {net} rupees. You earned {gross} rupees. {deductions} rupees was taken for PF, ESI and advances. Overtime: {ot} hours, {otPay} rupees.
report.title: Report danger
report.placeholder: Example: rope missing on the 4th floor scaffolding
report.anonymousHelp: Your name is never saved with this report. Only this phone can follow it.
report.sent: Report sent. You can follow it below.
report.urgent: If someone is hurt, call for help now.
report.describeFirst: Say or type a few words about it.
feedback.title: Speak up
feedback.intro: Your name is never saved. Results are shown only when 5 or more people answer.
feedback.pay: Is your pay fair and on time?
feedback.safety: Do you feel safe at work?
feedback.respect: Does your supervisor treat you with respect?
feedback.sent: Thank you. Your answer was saved without your name.
feedback.done: You have answered this week. Come back next week.
skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: Your work record goes with you to any job.
skills.sharing: Anyone with the link can see your skills and work days. Not your phone number.
